decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully limits referral, ticket, and payout reporting to active-replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy-contract data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully restricts random commission recipients to owners of active-replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract owners.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully records that Transak purchases mint through the active replacement contract only.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already fully records that ETH wallet mints use the active replacement contract only.
